description.en: A real educational advisory from a bank reminding customers never to disclose credentials.
description.hi: बैंक का वास्तविक परामर्श जो ग्राहकों को ओटीपी कभी साझा न करने की सलाह देता है।

lines.text: Dear customer, this is an automated security advisory from State Bank of India.
Cyber fraudsters are currently making fraudulent calls impersonating police and customs.
Please remember that bank employees will never ask for your card PIN, CVV, or OTP.
Never transfer money to any unknown third-party account under pressure or urgency.
If you suspect any fraudulent activity, immediately report it to cybercrime helpline 1930.
Stay vigilant, keep your banking credentials confidential, and have a safe day.
